name: cutpoint_crossing_brackets
purpose: DECISION_2026-09-11_scope_and_pivot.md §4 week 2 -- report calibration crossings as brackets, not precise thresholds. Derived from the committed per-bin calibration; no sweep is re-run.
bracket_definition: lower = n_cells_mature median of the highest bin that fails the criterion below the crossing; upper = median of the first bin that meets it. Endpoints are bin medians, the calibration's own resolution; no interpolation to integer counts is attempted. status='not_identifiable' means no bin met the criterion; status='below_first_bin' means the smallest tested bin already met it, so the crossing is at or below the grid rather than absent.
